detailed_descriptions.en: Ledgerbound is proud to present our Deluxe Supporter Edition - the second-best way to show your love and appreciation to Ledgerbound's team! This Supporter Pack lets us continue to work on Ledgerbound and is a way for players to chip in a little extra to support development. This DLC contains exclusive, luxurious incentives to reward your generosity: Digital Soundtrack: With over forty tracks composed by Diego Chi. Naked Hatrack: A special camp-only skin. Rated 18+. (Just kidding, it's a hat rack!) Accessorize Merp: This dapper hat will look adorable on your team mascot, Merp! Supporter Swag: This lanyard grants you a powerful in-game bonus: +5 strength against all enemies that spent less than you on Ledgerbound. (That's all of them!) Deluxe Settings Menu: No longer will you have to endure the plebian's pause and menu aesthetics. As a Deluxe Supporter, you'll enjoy a luxurious skin for your menus! Instant Win Button: For those who care only about the destination. This button lets you complete the entirety of Ledgerbound in a single flourish. Great for speed-runners who gotta go fast! Support the Team: Every bit helps! We've got big plans for Ledgerbound and this gets us on step closer to achieving them.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Ledgerbound is proud to present our Deluxe Supporter Edition - the second-best way to show your love and appreciation to Ledgerbound's team! This Supporter Pack lets us continue to work on Ledgerbound and is a way for players to chip in a little extra to support development. 

This DLC contains exclusive, luxurious incentives to reward your generosity: 

  • Digital Soundtrack: With over forty tracks composed by Diego Chi.

  • Naked Hatrack: A special camp-only skin. Rated 18+. (Just kidding, it's a hat rack!)

  • Accessorize Merp: This dapper hat will look adorable on your team mascot, Merp!

  • Supporter Swag: This lanyard grants you a powerful in-game bonus: +5 strength against all enemies that spent less than you on Ledgerbound. (That's all of them!)

  • Deluxe Settings Menu: No longer will you have to endure the plebian's pause and menu aesthetics. As a Deluxe Supporter, you'll enjoy a luxurious skin for your menus!

  • Instant Win Button: For those who care only about the destination. This button lets you complete the entirety of Ledgerbound in a single flourish. Great for speed-runners who gotta go fast!

  • Support the Team: Every bit helps! We've got big plans for Ledgerbound and this gets us on step closer to achieving them.
